target: pitcher and lid of the leaf (no PO class; at most a part of the vascular leaf, not the whole leaf)
fix: In 'Colour of outer pitcher and lid X to Y', the colour belongs to the pitcher and lid named after 'Colour of'. It does not belong to the whole leaf, whose blade is described separately ('Lower leaf blades').
reason: The yellow is the outside colour of the pitcher and its lid, which are only part of a Nepenthes leaf. Read as a colour of the whole vascular leaf, the statement is false. The blade is described on its own. 'to yellow' is also only the middle step of 'cream to yellow to pale green'.
'Stems ... grayish' gives stem colour gray, marked as approximate. Matches the source.
Leaflet blades 'abaxially with dense ... trichomes' means the lower surface is hairy. The leaf abaxial epidermis covers the leaflet's lower side, and 'pubescent hair' captures hairiness.
PO lists 'scape' as a narrow synonym of stem, so 'Scape 8–30 cm' is stem length 8–30 cm.
The Myriophyllum mericarp description ends 'wings and ridges absent'. Mericarp not winged is right. The ridges are simply not captured, which does not make this wrong.
'Graines obovoïdes' means the seeds are obovoid. Seed + obovoid matches.
'Leaf blade ... margin glandular dentate' means the leaf lamina margin is toothed. The word 'glandular' is not captured but nothing is false.
'Leaf blade ... abaxially ... usually powdery-pubescent' means the lower surface of the blade is pubescent, with 'usually' kept as a frequency qualifier.
'branches hispid or pubescent, becoming glabrous with age' means the branches are glabrous when old. The 'old' context is set.

target: range from elliptic-lanceolate (the in-between shape) to elliptic
fix: In 'A-B to A', the hyphen word A-B is one in-between shape and is the start of the 'to' range. The pipeline read only the hyphen word as a continuum from A to B and dropped 'to elliptic'. The range then wrongly takes in fully lanceolate leaflets.
reason: The flora gives a range from elliptic-lanceolate to elliptic. Lanceolate itself is outside that range, but the stored continuum elliptic→lanceolate includes it.
'phyllaries ..., the inner ciliate' means the inner bracts are ciliate. The 'inner' position is set, and a phyllary is a bract.
'innermost ones spatulate' refers to the phyllaries. Inner bract + spatulate matches.

fix: The word 'basal' is lost. A position slot (basal leaves) would make this more exact, but the statement stays true without it.
reason: Basal leaves numerous means the plant has many leaves. That is true even though the stems themselves are few-leaved.
'Pedicels not jointed' is a negated 'jointed' on the pedicel. Matches.
'bractées involucrales plusieurs' means several involucral bracts are present. Bract present, amount several, matches. An involucral bract class would be more specific.
'ramose' means branched. Root branched matches.
'leaf blade ... both surfaces glabrous' gives leaf lamina glabrous.

target: range from ovate/ovoid (PATO_0001891) to oblong-ovoid (in-between shape), not to oblong (PATO_0000946)
fix: In 'A to B-A', the end of the range is the hyphen word B-A, an in-between shape. Only its first part was used, so the end became 'oblong'. That is a flat (2-D) shape, and it is outside the stated range.
reason: The buds range from ovoid to oblong-ovoid. They are never simply oblong, so the stored range is wrong at its end.

fix: For mosses, non-vascular leaf (PO_0025075) would be the more exact bearer. Also, 'Branch leaves' is cut down to plain 'leaves'.
reason: The 1.5-3.8 mm is the length of the moss branch leaves, which are leaves. The statement is true as given, just less exact.
'stipules 1.5-8 mm' gives stipule length 1.5–8 mm.
'Cauline leaves ... subleathery' gives leaf coriaceous, marked as approximate.

fix: 'N+' means at least N. It should give a lower bound with an open top, not the exact range N–N.
reason: 'Disc florets 50+' means 50 or more, but the annotation stores exactly 50.
'Involucral bracts ... shorter than inflorescence' gives bract shorter, compared with the inflorescence.
'style de 3–4 mm de long' means the style is 3–4 mm long.

target: range from ovate (FLOPO_0991024) to oblong-ovate (in-between shape)
fix: Same cause as A04959 and A04967. In 'A to B-A', the pipeline read only the hyphen word as a continuum from B to A and dropped the 'A to' range. The stored continuum then includes the outer value B (oblong), which the flora never allows.
reason: The blades range from ovate to oblong-ovate. Oblong is not included, but the stored continuum oblong→ovate includes it.
'ovate-triangular' is one in-between shape. Following the usual convention, it is stored as a continuum from ovate to triangular on the sepals.
'erect-spreading when moist' gives leaf semi erect, with the moist condition set.
'Annuals, not rhizomatous' means no rhizome is present. The absence is right.
'pedicels up to 18 mm long in fruit' gives pedicel length up to 18 mm during the fruit stage (PO:0001002).

The ultimate segments of the divided blade are lanceolate to oblong, a range between two values. In this ternate-pinnate leaf the segments could also be read as leaflets, but the lobe bearer is acceptable.
